blocks.text: Some area pages on this site use photographs that other photographers have shared under open licences on Wikimedia Commons. Each photo carries its credit directly underneath it, and every photo is listed here with the photographer, the licence and a link to the original file.

We resize and compress every photo for the web, and where a wide panorama had to be trimmed to fit the page we say so in its caption. Photos shared under a Creative Commons Attribution licence may be reused with credit; photos shared under a ShareAlike licence carry the same condition for anyone who adapts the image itself. Jared’s own photographs replace these as they are taken.
If you took one of these photos and would like the credit changed or the photo removed, email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca with the page and we will fix it.
